name: java
title: Java Programming
description: A comprehensive course covering Java from fundamentals to advanced concepts. Learn object-oriented programming, collections, multithreading, and more.

chapters.title: Java Fundamentals
chapters.description: Learn the basics of Java programming including syntax, data types, and control flow.

lessons.title: Introduction to Java
lessons.objective: Understand what Java is and set up your development environment

lessons.title: Variables and Data Types
lessons.objective: Learn about primitive types, variables, and type conversion

lessons.title: Operators and Expressions
lessons.objective: Master arithmetic, logical, and comparison operators

lessons.title: Control Flow Statements
lessons.objective: Understand if-else, switch, loops, and branching

chapters.title: Object-Oriented Programming
chapters.description: Master the core OOP concepts that make Java powerful.

lessons.title: Classes and Objects
lessons.objective: Learn to define classes and create objects

lessons.title: Inheritance and Polymorphism
lessons.objective: Understand inheritance hierarchies and polymorphic behavior

lessons.title: Interfaces and Abstract Classes
lessons.objective: Learn to design with interfaces and abstract classes

lessons.title: Encapsulation and Access Modifiers
lessons.objective: Master access control and data hiding

chapters.title: Java Collections Framework
chapters.description: Explore the rich set of collection classes and interfaces.

lessons.title: List and Set Interfaces
lessons.objective: Understand ArrayList, LinkedList, HashSet, and TreeSet

lessons.title: Map and Queue Interfaces
lessons.objective: Learn HashMap, TreeMap, PriorityQueue, and Deque

lessons.title: Streams and Lambda Expressions
lessons.objective: Master functional programming with streams

lessons.title: Collections Utility Methods
lessons.objective: Learn sorting, searching, and utility operations

chapters.title: Exception Handling and I/O
chapters.description: Learn to handle errors gracefully and work with files.

lessons.title: Exception Types and Hierarchy
lessons.objective: Understand checked and unchecked exceptions

lessons.title: Try-Catch and Custom Exceptions
lessons.objective: Learn exception handling patterns

lessons.title: File I/O and Serialization
lessons.objective: Read and write files, object serialization

lessons.title: NIO and Modern I/O
lessons.objective: Explore the NIO.2 API for modern file operations

lessons.title: Threads and Runnable
lessons.objective: Create and manage threads

lessons.title: Synchronization and Locks
lessons.objective: Learn thread safety and synchronization

lessons.title: Executor Framework
lessons.objective: Use thread pools and executors

lessons.title: Concurrent Collections
lessons.objective: Explore thread-safe collections
